```{r setup}
#| output: false
if (basename(getwd()) == "09_reporting") setwd("..")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(gt)
  library(jsonlite)
})

gpk       <- as.integer(params$game_pk)
game_date <- as.character(params$game_date)
away_abbr <- params$away_abbr
home_abbr <- params$home_abbr

# Pandoc's default markdown reader treats a bare <div> as a "native Div"
# and parses its CONTENTS as markdown rather than passing them through
# as raw text. A multi-line HTML string literal written with the R
# source's own indentation (as below, for readability) then has its
# continuation lines misread as an indented code block (4+ leading
# spaces = code block in CommonMark), rendering literal escaped tags
# instead of the intended layout. Strip leading whitespace after each
# newline before cat()'ing any multi-line raw-HTML string.
.flatten_indent <- function(x) gsub("\n[ \t]+", "\n", x)

# ── MLB Stats API helpers ──────────────────────────────────────

mlb_get <- function(path) {
  url <- paste0("https://statsapi.mlb.com", path)
  tryCatch(
    jsonlite::fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = TRUE, flatten = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

# ── Pull linescore ─────────────────────────────────────────────
ls_data <- mlb_get(paste0("/api/v1/game/", gpk, "/linescore"))

# ── Pull boxscore ─────────────────────────────────────────────
bs_data <- mlb_get(paste0("/api/v1/game/", gpk, "/boxscore"))

# ── Check predictions log ──────────────────────────────────────
log_path <- "data/predictions_log.csv"
pred_row <- if (file.exists(log_path)) {
  tryCatch(
    readr::read_csv(log_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::filter(game_pk == !!gpk) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 1),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
} else NULL

# ── Extract key fields ─────────────────────────────────────────
away_name  <- tryCatch(bs_data$teams$away$team$name,  error = function(e) away_abbr)
home_name  <- tryCatch(bs_data$teams$home$team$name,  error = function(e) home_abbr)
away_score <- tryCatch(ls_data$teams$away$runs,       error = function(e) NA_integer_)
home_score <- tryCatch(ls_data$teams$home$runs,       error = function(e) NA_integer_)
away_hits  <- tryCatch(ls_data$teams$away$hits,       error = function(e) NA_integer_)
home_hits  <- tryCatch(ls_data$teams$home$hits,       error = function(e) NA_integer_)
away_err   <- tryCatch(ls_data$teams$away$errors,     error = function(e) NA_integer_)
home_err   <- tryCatch(ls_data$teams$home$errors,     error = function(e) NA_integer_)

winner <- if (!is.na(away_score) && !is.na(home_score)) {
  if (away_score > home_score) away_name else home_name
} else NA_character_
```

```{r scoreline}
#| output: asis
cat(sprintf("# %s @ %s\n\n", away_name, home_name))
cat(sprintf(
  "> **%s** · %s\n\n",
  format(as.Date(game_date), "%A, %B %d, %Y"),
  if (!is.na(winner)) paste0("**", winner, " win**") else "Result unavailable"
))

# Big score display
if (!is.na(away_score) && !is.na(home_score)) {
  cat(.flatten_indent(sprintf(
    '<div style="display:flex;gap:3rem;align-items:center;
      background:#f8f9fa;border:1px solid #dee2e6;border-radius:10px;
      padding:20px 32px;margin:1rem 0 1.5rem;max-width:480px;">
      <div style="text-align:center;">
        <div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#666;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;">%s</div>
        <div style="font-size:3rem;font-weight:800;color:%s;line-height:1.1;">%d</div>
        <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#888;">%d H · %d E</div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:1.5rem;color:#aaa;font-weight:300;">@</div>
      <div style="text-align:center;">
        <div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#666;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;">%s</div>
        <div style="font-size:3rem;font-weight:800;color:%s;line-height:1.1;">%d</div>
        <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#888;">%d H · %d E</div>
      </div>
    </div>\n\n',
    away_name,
    if (away_score > home_score) "#1a5276" else "#5d6d7e",
    away_score,
    coalesce(away_hits, 0L), coalesce(away_err, 0L),
    home_name,
    if (home_score > away_score) "#1a5276" else "#5d6d7e",
    home_score,
    coalesce(home_hits, 0L), coalesce(home_err, 0L)
  )))
} else {
  cat('<p style="color:#888;font-style:italic;">Final score not yet available.</p>\n\n')
}
```

```{r prediction-compare}
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(pred_row) && nrow(pred_row) > 0) {
  p <- pred_row
  correct <- isTRUE(p$correct_winner)
  result_badge <- if (correct) {
    '<span style="background:#198754;color:white;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:700;font-size:0.85rem;">✓ Correct pick</span>'
  } else {
    '<span style="background:#dc3545;color:white;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:700;font-size:0.85rem;">✗ Wrong pick</span>'
  }

  cat("## Our Prediction\n\n")
  cat(.flatten_indent(sprintf(
    '<div style="background:#f0f4ff;border:1px solid #c5d4f5;border-radius:8px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
      <div style="margin-bottom:8px;">%s &nbsp; Predicted: <strong>%s</strong></div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:2rem;font-size:0.9rem;">
        <div><span style="color:#666;">Predicted score:</span> <strong>%s %s – %s %s</strong></div>
        <div><span style="color:#666;">Actual score:</span> <strong>%s %s – %s %s</strong></div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:0.85rem;color:#555;">
        Away win probability: <strong>%s%%</strong> &nbsp;·&nbsp; Home win probability: <strong>%s%%</strong>
      </div>
    </div>\n\n',
    result_badge,
    coalesce(p$predicted_winner, "—"),
    p$away_team, round(p$pred_away_runs, 1),
    p$home_team, round(p$pred_home_runs, 1),
    p$away_team, coalesce(p$actual_away_runs, NA_real_),
    p$home_team, coalesce(p$actual_home_runs, NA_real_),
    round(coalesce(p$away_win_pct, 0) * 100),
    round(coalesce(p$home_win_pct, 0) * 100)
  )))
}
```

```{r linescore-table}
#| output: asis
cat("## Linescore\n\n")

innings_raw <- tryCatch(ls_data$innings, error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(innings_raw) && length(innings_raw) > 0) {
  innings_df <- tryCatch(
    as.data.frame(innings_raw, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(innings_df) && nrow(innings_df) > 0) {
    # Build wide linescore: rows = team, cols = each inning + R/H/E
    n_inn   <- nrow(innings_df)
    inn_nums <- innings_df$num

    away_inn_runs <- innings_df$away.runs
    home_inn_runs <- innings_df$home.runs

    # Replace NA (walk-off 9th etc.) with "X"
    fmt_inn <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "X", as.character(x))

    ls_tbl <- data.frame(
      Team = c(away_name, home_name),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    for (j in seq_len(n_inn)) {
      col_nm <- as.character(inn_nums[j])
      ls_tbl[[col_nm]] <- c(
        fmt_inn(away_inn_runs[j]),
        fmt_inn(home_inn_runs[j])
      )
    }
    ls_tbl[["R"]] <- c(coalesce(away_score, 0L), coalesce(home_score, 0L))
    ls_tbl[["H"]] <- c(coalesce(away_hits,  0L), coalesce(home_hits,  0L))
    ls_tbl[["E"]] <- c(coalesce(away_err,   0L), coalesce(home_err,   0L))

    tbl <- ls_tbl %>%
      gt::gt() %>%
      gt::tab_style(
        style    = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c("R", "H", "E"))
      ) %>%
      gt::tab_style(
        style    = gt::cell_fill(color = "#e8f4ea"),
        locations = gt::cells_body(
          columns = "R",
          rows    = R == max(R)
        )
      ) %>%
      gt::tab_options(table.font.size = 13, data_row.padding = gt::px(5)) %>%
      gt::fmt_missing(columns = dplyr::everything(), missing_text = "—")

    cat(gt::as_raw_html(tbl), "\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat('<p style="color:#888;font-style:italic;">Linescore not available.</p>\n\n')
}
```

```{r pitching-lines}
#| output: asis
cat("## Pitching\n\n")

get_pitching_lines <- function(side_data) {
  pitchers <- tryCatch(side_data$pitchers, error = function(e) NULL)
  all_stats <- tryCatch(side_data$players, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(pitchers) || is.null(all_stats)) return(NULL)

  rows <- lapply(pitchers, function(pid) {
    key    <- paste0("ID", pid)
    p_info <- all_stats[[key]]
    if (is.null(p_info)) return(NULL)

    stats <- tryCatch(p_info$stats$pitching$summary, error = function(e) "")
    name  <- tryCatch(p_info$person$fullName,        error = function(e) as.character(pid))
    note  <- tryCatch(p_info$gameStatus$note,         error = function(e) "")
    if (is.null(note) || length(note) == 0) note <- ""

    data.frame(
      Pitcher   = name,
      Note      = note,
      Line      = if (is.null(stats) || length(stats) == 0) "—" else stats,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

away_pitching <- get_pitching_lines(tryCatch(bs_data$teams$away, error = function(e) list()))
home_pitching <- get_pitching_lines(tryCatch(bs_data$teams$home, error = function(e) list()))

render_pitching_gt <- function(df, team_name) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(dplyr::tibble(Note = "Pitching data not available.") %>%
             gt::gt() %>% gt::tab_header(title = team_name))
  }
  df %>%
    gt::gt() %>%
    gt::tab_header(title = team_name) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style     = gt::cell_text(color = "#198754", weight = "bold"),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = "Note",
                                  rows = grepl("W|Win", Note, ignore.case = TRUE))
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style     = gt::cell_text(color = "#dc3545"),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = "Note",
                                  rows = grepl("L|Loss", Note, ignore.case = TRUE))
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = 13, data_row.padding = gt::px(4)) %>%
    gt::fmt_missing(columns = dplyr::everything(), missing_text = "—")
}

away_p_html <- gt::as_raw_html(render_pitching_gt(away_pitching, away_name))
home_p_html <- gt::as_raw_html(render_pitching_gt(home_pitching, home_name))

cat(paste0(
  '<div style="display:flex;gap:2rem;align-items:flex-start;width:100%;">',
  '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto;">', away_p_html, '</div>',
  '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto;">', home_p_html, '</div>',
  '</div>'
), "\n\n")
```

```{r batting-highlights}
#| output: asis
cat("## Batting Highlights\n\n")

get_batting_leaders <- function(side_data, team_name) {
  batters  <- tryCatch(side_data$batters, error = function(e) NULL)
  all_stats <- tryCatch(side_data$players, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(batters) || is.null(all_stats)) return(NULL)

  rows <- lapply(batters, function(bid) {
    key    <- paste0("ID", bid)
    b_info <- all_stats[[key]]
    if (is.null(b_info)) return(NULL)

    s     <- tryCatch(b_info$stats$batting, error = function(e) list())
    name  <- tryCatch(b_info$person$fullName, error = function(e) as.character(bid))

    # MLB API returns NULL (not an error) for fields that don't apply to a
    # player (e.g. a pitcher's batting stats in an NL/interleague game with
    # no PA) — as.integer(NULL) is integer(0), not NA, so is.na(ab) on it
    # returns logical(0) and crashes the if() below. Force length-1 first.
    safe_int <- function(x) {
      v <- tryCatch(as.integer(x), error = function(e) NA_integer_)
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_integer_ else v
    }
    ab   <- safe_int(s$atBats)
    h    <- safe_int(s$hits)
    hr   <- safe_int(s$homeRuns)
    rbi  <- safe_int(s$rbi)
    bb   <- safe_int(s$baseOnBalls)
    k    <- safe_int(s$strikeOuts)
    sb   <- safe_int(s$stolenBases)

    if (is.na(ab) || ab == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      Player = name, AB = ab, H = h, HR = hr, RBI = rbi,
      BB = bb, K = k, SB = sb,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(H), dplyr::desc(HR), dplyr::desc(RBI)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 9)
}

away_bat <- get_batting_leaders(tryCatch(bs_data$teams$away, error = function(e) list()), away_name)
home_bat <- get_batting_leaders(tryCatch(bs_data$teams$home, error = function(e) list()), home_name)

render_batting_gt <- function(df, team_name) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(dplyr::tibble(Note = "Batting data not available.") %>%
             gt::gt() %>% gt::tab_header(title = team_name))
  }
  df %>%
    gt::gt() %>%
    gt::tab_header(title = team_name) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style     = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#7950f2"),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = "HR", rows = HR > 0)
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = 13, data_row.padding = gt::px(4)) %>%
    gt::fmt_missing(columns = dplyr::everything(), missing_text = "—")
}

away_b_html <- gt::as_raw_html(render_batting_gt(away_bat, away_name))
home_b_html <- gt::as_raw_html(render_batting_gt(home_bat, home_name))

cat(paste0(
  '<div style="display:flex;gap:2rem;align-items:flex-start;width:100%;">',
  '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto;">', away_b_html, '</div>',
  '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto;">', home_b_html, '</div>',
  '</div>'
), "\n\n")
```
